fullDescription:
Hi, I am Vijet Hegde — a Computer Science and Engineering student at AMC Engineering College, Bengaluru, and a full-stack engineer focused on backend platforms, developer tooling, and applied machine learning. I build scalable REST APIs with FastAPI and Django REST Framework, ship React and React Native interfaces, optimize PostgreSQL-backed systems, and automate deployment workflows with Git, Docker, Linux, Bash, and CI/CD.

Recently, I worked as a Full Stack Engineer Intern at Dscape.ai Pvt. Ltd., where I architected high-performance APIs, improved database-backed services, debugged legacy bottlenecks, and collaborated with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. My project work includes GeoGenie, an AI monument history generator using CLIP embeddings and FAISS search, and Review Guard, a fake-review detection platform powered by classical ML pipelines.

I enjoy creating reliable software that feels fast, practical, and easy to maintain.
